messages:
Iris (Marketing): Hey all — dropped a fresh draft of the launch post in the doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1fresh-launch. Need quick sanity on hero claim, benchmark sentence, and webinar routing.
Cal (Product): On hero: currently reads "35% lower per-token spend". Is that median or best-case? we should add "up to" or specify workload.
Iris (Marketing): Source is Optimize bench on retriever-heavy queries. Suggest: "Up to 35% lower per-token spend for retrieval-heavy apps (internal benchmark)"?
Ruth (Legal): "Up to 35%" is fine. please add a short methodology line in the appendix and link to the run logs. remove the customer snippet until approval.
Sam (Growth): For the webinar CTA we should capture intent: radio buttons for "Self-serve trial" and "Sales demo" so HubSpot can route leads. UTM pattern: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q3&utm_content=webinar_cta. add content=heroV1 for AB tracking.
Jae (Design): Figma hero variants uploaded — included a compact headline option so the subhead (latency callout) fits above the fold. I also exported OG 1200x630 and a square thumbnail.
Cal (Product): latency subhead currently says "p95 < 150ms". need config: suggest "p95 ≈150ms on short-context tests (Dedicated config, seq=128)". keeps it honest.
Ruth (Legal): also added webinar privacy text in the doc: "By registering you consent to receive product updates; see our privacy policy." please include a checkbox.
forms-bot: created form id hb-20240715-09 and webhook at /hooks/hubspot/hb-20240715-09. test event delivered (status 200).
Sam (Growth): HubSpot mapping: lead_source=blog_post, intent_bucket={self_serve|sales}, campaign=2024-Q3-Dedicated. I will create the Salesforce campaign and post the id here.
Iris (Marketing): Great — next steps: 1) Cal add bench appendix link and one-line method, 2) Ruth final legal copy (privacy + claim tweak), 3) Sam wire HubSpot + SFDC campaign, 4) Jae finalize hero OG. aiming to publish Thurs AM. please ack when finished. :rocket:
Cal (Product): I'll add the appendix now.
Ruth (Legal): quick-pass done, adjusted phrasing per above.
Sam (Growth): SFDC campaign created: SF-2024-DL-33. HubSpot mapping live.
Jae (Design): OGs finalized and uploaded to the doc.
Iris (Marketing): Thanks team — leaving thread for final publish ack. :eyes:
